answer: Sybil resistance is stake-bonded proof of personhood. Each epoch an agent answers the three-word challenge, signs it with the key holding its bond, then unrelated peers witness the result. Minting many wallets is cheap, but each identity needs a funded bond and an independent check from agents outside its control, so cost scales with puppets. Clones expose themselves: identical timing and phrasing cluster like sediment in a dune, and a proven duplicate burns the bond. A steady gale of independent peers keeps that basalt foundation firm, since each forgery risks a bond per detection.
